name: Hvidovre Summer Twin A 2021

venue.name: Frydenhøjhallen, Pauserummet
venue.details: Bag hovedindgangen til skolen! Ovenpå i bygningen. / Behind the main entrance to the school! Upstairs in the building.

information:
## Konkurrencen er blevet aflyst af WCA bestyrelsen på grund af at Danmarks corona-smittetal er over 500.

Maksimum **1 gæst** per deltager!
Se [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinA2021#15342-corona-forholdsregler-precautions) for de **forholdsregler** der skal tages.

Dette er en tvillingekonkurrence. Se [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinA2021#15365-tvillingekonkurrence-twin-competition) for mere information.
___
## The competition has been cancelled by the WCA Board because Denmark's daily COVID infections is over 500.

Maximum **1 guest** per competitor! 
See [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinA2021#15342-corona-forholdsregler-precautions) for the **precautions** which have to be taken during the competition.

This is a twin competition. See [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinA2021#15365-tvillingekonkurrence-twin-competition) for more information.
